item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Establish whether diagnostics measure the deployed BERT4Rec task correctly. Seek practical invariance tests for left padding, final nonpadding readout, reserved mask tokens, and appended-mask inference, plus leakage tests ensuring masked targets are absent from bidirectional inputs. Connect failures to masking, attention, and predictor implementation before interpreting recommendation quality.","query":"BERT4Rec masked item prediction diagnostic testing target leakage appended mask inference left padding positional encoding invariance 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Develop controlled history perturbations that distinguish broad resemblance from specific recent intent. Using only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions, compare recent-item removal, older-item removal, and order changes; measure rank changes for specific versus broad matches. Seek feedback annotation protocols separating immediate choice, deferred relevance, explicit mismatch, and unidentified items, without inferring equipment ownership or unobserved traits.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic counterfactual history perturbation recency specificity next item intent user feedback abstention missing item identity 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Replace isolated training margins and mean embedding cosine with calibrated failure profiles: candidate difficulty, popularity and history-length strata, embedding effective rank, and uncertainty intervals. Investigate agreement between inexpensive training-history prefix probes and pinned validation HR@10 across all four datasets, while distinguishing sampled-candidate diagnostics from full-catalog recommendation behavior. Preserve one trained model per category and keep diagnostic scores out of prediction fusion.","query":"recommender system diagnostic validation sampled negatives full catalog ranking popularity bias hard negatives embedding effective rank bootstrap uncertainty HR@10 2024 2025 2026"}]}
